# National Ataxia Foundation

> The National Ataxia Foundation provides comprehensive patient education, research tracking, and community support for ataxia and related neurological disorders.

The site serves as a central resource for ataxia patients, researchers, and caregivers, featuring disease information, clinical trial pipelines, annual conferences, and expert-led educational content. It combines medical reference materials with advocacy initiatives and pharmaceutical development tracking.

## Key Topics

- Ataxia
- Spinocerebellar Ataxia (SCA)
- Friedreich's Ataxia (FA)
- Cerebellum
- Clinical Trials
- Drug Development
- Patient Education
- Annual Ataxia Conference
- Rare Disease
- Neurological Disorder
- FDA Approval
- Treatment Pipeline
- Genetic Disorder
- Bill Nye
- Dr. Susan Perlman

## Disease Information & Overview

- [What is Ataxia?](https://www.ataxia.org/what-is-ataxia): Overview of ataxia disease, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment information for patients.
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.ataxia.org/fact-sheets): Downloadable fact sheets on ataxia types, symptoms, and management for patients.

## Research & Clinical Development

- [Pipeline](https://www.ataxia.org/pipeline): Treatment pipeline tracker for SCA1, SCA2, and other ataxia types in clinical development.
- [Pharma News](https://www.ataxia.org/pharmanews): Pharmaceutical news on ataxia drug development, clinical trials, and FDA approvals.
- [SCAsource](https://www.ataxia.org/scasource): Scientific articles on SCA research, cerebellar function, and neuroscience topics.

## Annual Ataxia Conference

- [2026 AAC - National Ataxia Foundation](http://www.ataxia.org/2026aac): 2026 Annual Ataxia Conference in Orlando with registration, travel grants, and virtual attendance options.
- [Annual Ataxia Conference](https://www.ataxia.org/annual-ataxia-conference): Annual Ataxia Conference hub with research, education, and support group information.

## Education & Expert Resources

- [Webinars](https://www.ataxia.org/webinars): On-demand webinar series on ataxia education, genetics, exercise, and financial planning.
- [Ask The Expert](https://www.ataxia.org/asktheexpert): Quarterly Q&A sessions with Dr. Susan Perlman on ataxia neurology and patient care.

## Advocacy & Awareness

- [Bill Nye for FA](https://www.ataxia.org/billnye-for-fa): Educational video on Friedreich ataxia and frataxin protein by Bill Nye.
- [Bill Nye](https://www.ataxia.org/BillNye): Bill Nye ataxia awareness and advocacy content for hereditary neurological disease.
